method: Revalidate full published MD5 and frozen SHA256 for each file. Reproduce R37F2D3 science gate. Native channels, same row normalization and science bounds; compare time-average and both non-overlapping time halves. Area-overlap integration via cumulative piecewise constant integral; verify algebra against pinned R37A on small test arrays. Report native-profile fidelity separately from 256-channel historical comparator. Do not change thresholds after results. Retain aggregate metrics only; no fine-grid samples in artifacts, no automatic processing decisions.
acceptance: All 48 comparisons at native resolution must meet original R37F3A thresholds; all damage/clean canaries must pass. Failed transforms remain HOLD; no threshold fitting, no deployment. Full support conservation alone insufficient.
scope: Historical natural astronomical data preservation only, no operational emitter profiling, identification, suppression, classifier or automatic exclusion, no production adoption. Not end-to-end HANNAH or blind validation.
